N1.name: N1
N1.note: Run N1: NEAT from random genomes (16 -> 32 random tanh hidden -> 4; NEAT adds and deletes nodes and connections freely), population 300, ~12 species. Every genome of a generation flies the same seeds; the top 10 re-fly 40 selection seeds. Pay: 0.3 x game score + 300 per landing - 200 per timeout - 100 per boulder touch. Stop when the champion lands >= 95% (200 real-task flights, then 1,000 fresh selection flights), or Friday 2026-11-06 17:00.

stages.name: 1 calm landing
stages.expect: Random networks crash at once. With training wheels (an upright torque fading 1 -> 0 over 100 generations) they should learn to hover, descend and land in calm air; >= 90% calm landings without wheels within ~150-250 generations. The real-task line stays low (no wind skill yet).

stages.name: 2 wind ramp
stages.expect: Over 200 generations the push grows from a steady 5 to the full gusty 15 plus turbulence 1.5. The networks must start using the clean wind estimate (input 16). Expect a dip while the gusts grow, then >= 85% landings in full wind without a boulder.

stages.name: 3 boulder
stages.expect: The boulder (layout v3) grows from 40% to full size over 200 generations; 40% of flights are the full real task (rehearsal). The route sensors (inputs 11-15) start to matter. Expect boulder touches to dominate the failures at first, then >= 85% on the real task.

stages.name: 4 real task + hard cases
stages.expect: The long one, no early stop. 30% of each generation's flights re-fly training seeds the recent champions failed (hard cases: PPO went from a 92.7% plateau to ~96% this way). Snapshots every 25 generations. The run stops when a champion holds >= 95% on 1,000 fresh selection flights.
